title: South swell brings high surf and strong rip currents to San Diego
description:
A south swell is bringing big waves and stronger rip currents to San Diego beaches. 🌊 

Lt. Charlie Knight reminds beachgoers if you’re caught in a rip current, stay calm, float on your back and go with the current, and wave your hand to signal for help. For experienced swimmers and surfers, swim parallel to shore, and then come back in with the waves.

Always check in with lifeguards before entering the water. Stay safe out there! 🏊 

More information: sandiego.gov/lifeguards/safety/ripcurrent
